[[File:Hero duo anime.png|thumb|250px|Zacian and Zamazenta]] The '''[[legendary heroes]]''' are a duo of [[Legendary Pokémon]] that appeared in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. The members are Zacian and Zamazenta who played a part in the [[Darkest Day]]. ==In animation== ===Zacian=== {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Fairy |ball=None |nickname=Zacian |jnickname=ザシアン |tmnickname=Zacian |image=[[File:Zacian anime.png|250px]]
Hero of Many Battles Zacian
[[File:Zacian Crowned Sword anime.png|250px]] |caption=Crowned Sword Zacian |caught=no |gender=Gender unknown |epnum=JN042 |epname=Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald! |ability=Unknown |prevonum=888 |noevo=incap |pokemonname=Zacian |current=[[Slumbering Weald]] |java1=Unknown |enva1= }} {{p|Zacian}} debuted in ''[[JN042|Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!]]'', when {{Ash}} encountered it in the [[Slumbering Weald]] after getting separated from [[Goh]]. After getting no data on Zacian from his [[Rotom Phone]], Ash attempted to battle it with {{AP|Pikachu}}, only for the attack to pass through Zacian before it disappeared. In ''[[JN044|Sword and Shield: From Here to Eternatus!]]'', Goh and [[Sonia]] arrived at the Slumbering Weald requesting the help of it and {{p|Zamazenta}} to deal with the [[Darkest Day]] crisis that had befallen [[Galar]]. Zacian appeared alongside Zamazenta and led Goh and Sonia to the Altar where they found the [[Rusted Sword]] and [[Rusted Shield|Shield]]. In ''[[JN045|Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!]]'', by using the Rusted Sword, Zacian turned into its Crowned Sword form and battled alongside Zamazenta in its Crowned Shield form and was able to take down {{TP|Goh|Eternatus}}, allowing it to be caught by Goh. After the battle, Ash and Goh returned the Rusted Sword and Shield to the Altar. Zacian reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN078|Detective Drizzile!]]''. Zacian reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]''. =====Personality and characteristics===== Zacian is a loyal Pokémon, as seen during the [[Darkest Day]] crisis, when it led [[Goh]] and [[Sonia]] to the Altar where they'd find the [[Rusted Sword]] and [[Rusted Shield|Shield]]. Zacian is also a strong Pokémon, as seen in ''[[JN045|Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!]]'', when it took on {{p|Eternatus}} alongside {{p|Zamazenta}} and was able to defeat it. =====Moves used===== ======Hero of Many Battles Zacian====== {{anmov/h|fairy}} {{anmov|steel|Iron Head|JN045|Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!{{tt|*|Confirmed through the use of Behemoth Blade}}}} {{anmov/f|fairy}} ======Crowned Sword Zacian====== {{anmov/h|fairy|steel|Zacian Behemoth Blade.png|Using Behemoth Blade}} {{anmov|steel|Behemoth Blade|JN045|Sword and Shield: The Legends Awaken!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} =====Artwork===== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{steel color dark}}; background: #{{fairy color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{steel color dark}}; background: #{{steel color light}}" | [[File:Pocket Monsters 2019 poster 2.png|x200px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{steel color dark}}; background: #{{steel color light}}" | [[File:Pocket Monsters 2019 poster 3.png|x200px]] |- | Third poster for the Japanese version of
